intent: The Cascade Machine: Wait for the spout to die, then cross the vent. Four connected expert trials with precise charge-dash catches.

sections.name: The spillway foot
sections.lesson: Ride the spillway updraft, leave sideways, then cross the breathing water vents.

signs.text:
The spillway foot
Ride the spray upward; catch the ledge before the vent.
